races.title: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Nursery Handicap
races.verdict: PREMIER VIEW has made a promising start to his career and is taken to make a quick return to winning ways. races.title: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: SURPASS AND SHINE had plenty in hand when landing a gamble over C&D 28 days ago, on just his second polytrack start and can follow up despite a 10 lb rise. Steel Magnolia returns to 6f after recent 5f runs and ran better when sixth here 21 days ago, so is feared most, while El Fontenaro bounced back to form when third here 16 days ago and should be involved.
